findings.title: Revise the hearing/listening sense text to explain the attested use
findings.details: The sense is now correctly marked `current`, cites present-day Chinese use (E20 and X-a22c9263b43c090a184a), and keeps the Song–Yuan attestation. Its text still spends much of its explanation on why the graph was reused and the unverified 𠯸/厅 proposal; it does not plainly describe the attested use of 听 for 聽 as hearing/listening. Keep original-priority and graphic-path uncertainty in cited formation, history, or limitations prose, and make the sense text explain the attested current use. The prior status defect is resolved; this is the remaining defect in the same finding.
findings.verification: Regenerate the sense and its `has_sense` edge from the revised meaning-history record. Confirm the sense cites present-day Chinese usage and explains the attested hearing/listening use; the edge should describe that use and its Song–Yuan attestation without including the separate borrowing proposal.
